note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after a few searches, so most of this part went by fetching official pages directly. Many county sites did not resolve or refused the kit's fetcher (Allen and Pulaski PVA sites 403, Glasgow 403, louisvilleky.gov 403, Laurel, Estill, Clinton, Owsley, Breckinridge, Gallatin, Carlisle, Wolfe and Livingston county addresses tried did not resolve or carried no names, Mason County Schools' certificate did not match its name, the Garrard and Ashland school sites draw their board lists by script), so 21 of the 30 candidates are left blank. Several candidates found here hold the office they seek today (Turner, Goehring, Plummer, Vaughan, Wigginton, Waller, Allen, Winkler) while our record's incumbent flag is 0 for them; the county clerks' filing lists do not mark local incumbents, so this is noted here rather than filed as a review item. Louisville Metro Council: the Jefferson County Clerk's official 2026 primary recap (elect.ky.gov, Jefferson.pdf, page 320) prints 'LOUISVILLE METRO COUNCIL District 17' without a party prefix and with Merideth Booth, Markus Winkler and Nancy-Lynne Walters in one field, while the same page prints 'DEM COUNTY ATTORNEY' and the like, so our 'Nonpartisan office' for this race agrees with the official record. Covington's Mayor and Commission page does not list Dan Francis; Whitley County Schools' Board Members page does not list Gary Perkins; Muhlenberg County's Magistrates page does not list Jeff Vincent. Gary York, Wade Burns, Andrew Adkins and the other unlisted names were not researched beyond the county pages that could be reached. Verifier (2026-10-03): every url re-opened; each finding below was seen on its page as recorded.
